a blank role column, marked implicit and.stdout:
+- GUI users -----------------------------+
|  alice  2026-01-02  [admin (implicit)]  |
|  bob    2026-01-03  [member]            |
+-----------------------------------------+
  (implicit) = the role column is blank, which means admin. That is the
  migration for accounts made before roles existed, not a default.
  narrow one with: houston users role alice member
